value.rationale: A natural inverse problem has a complete best-possible observable (difference-body) classification and a sharp constituent-number boundary: two exposed ball hulls are reconstructible, but three disjoint exposed ball hulls need not be, even given all labeled widths. The obstruction changes the mathematical identifiability landscape and is not an arbitrary finite parameter exercise.
